articles.title: Ashmore Bets on Mexico’s Booming Pension Funds With Equity Fund
articles.summary: Ashmore Group is launching a Mexican equities fund as it looks to capitalize on investments by the country’s rapidly growing pension fund system.

articles.title: US Bonds Drop as Doubt Over US-Iran Talks Lifts Oil Prices
articles.summary: Treasuries sank as an impasse in negotiations between the US and Iran fueled concern that higher energy costs will stoke inflation and push the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates.

articles.title: Power Company ERock Seeks to Raise $642 Million in IPO
articles.summary: ERock Inc. is seeking to raise as much as $642 million from an initial public offering, joining a rush of listings ahead of SpaceX later this month.

articles.title: Emerging Currencies Snap Winning Streak as Peace Deal in Doubt
articles.summary: Emerging-market currencies sank on waning hopes for a peace deal in the Middle East after a report that Iran had stopped exchanging messages with the US in protest at Israel’s actions in Lebanon.

articles.title: US Stocks Muted on Report Iran Is Halting Messages With US
articles.summary: US stocks were muted on Monday after an Iranian report that the country will stop exchanging messages with the US, triggering a spike in oil prices.

articles.title: Colombian Assets Surge as Right-Wing Outsider Leads Vote
articles.summary: Colombia’s stocks leaped by the most in over six years and bonds and the currency surged after right-wing outsider Abelardo de La Espriella unexpectedly won the first-round of voting for the presidency and went into the runoff as clear favorite against leftist Ivan Cepeda.

articles.title: AI Rally, Haven Flows Boost Trader Bets on Further Dollar Gains
articles.summary: Traders are betting the US dollar will rise in the weeks ahead, supported by lingering uncertainty over US-Iran talks and an AI-fueled rally in US stocks.

articles.title: IBM Shares Surge as Old Clip of Trump Praise Recirculates Online
articles.summary: A nearly six-month old video of Donald Trump praising International Business Machines Corp.’s CEO sent the shares surging almost 9% on Monday, adding more than $24 billion to the company’s stock-market value.

articles.title: South Africa Factory Sentiment Worsens as Demand Fades
articles.summary: South Africa’s manufacturer sentiment worsened in May as demand slumped and supply disruptions due to the Iran war continued.

articles.title: FedEx Freight Shares Drop in First Day of Trading After Spinoff
articles.summary: Shares of FedEx Corp.’s former freight division fell on Monday in their first day of trading as an independent, publicly held company.

articles.title: US Extends Deadline for Trilogy Metals Equity Stake Purchase
articles.summary: Trilogy Metals Inc. said the US is giving the critical minerals miner more time to finalize the Pentagon’s planned $35.6 million equity investment in the company.

articles.title: Chile Investors Turn Back to Peso Notes as If War Never Happened
articles.summary: As Washington inches closer to a deal with Iran, Chilean investors are moving back into short-term peso bonds, wagering that inflation fears sparked by the Middle East conflict are a thing of the past.

articles.title: JPMorgan Casts Doubt on Speculative Tech After 57% Rally
articles.summary: The riskiest corners of the tech sector are outperforming their larger peers at the fastest pace in nearly six years. Now, many on Wall Street are sounding a warning to investors holding those stocks: Get out while you can.

articles.title: General Dynamics Will Spend $200 Million to Reboot Ammo Plant
articles.summary: General Dynamics Corp. will invest $200 million of its own money and unwind a partnership with Turkish defense contractor Repkon in a bid to finally start producing 155mm artillery shells at a Texas plant that’s been beset by delays, people familiar with the matter said.
